$comment: Proposal templates: which toolbox components make each page, in order. npm run site:new -- <template> writes them into site/. Each entry is one section file; an entry with several names joins them in one file (the glance band shares the hero's).

data-proposal.for: A proposal where the reader compares options and tries numbers: a pricing or savings case, a plan with tiers, a business case a buyer forwards.

proposal.for: A standard proposal with no calculator: a scope of work, a partnership, a service with one price.
